constraints: Append to existing Wave1; do not shorten or rearrange Wave1 in this delivery.

Hole counts mean follow-ups after initial elbow breach, not total breach holes.
Art/native review must verify elbow and ramp geometry, overhead cues, cap/porcelain support and camera framing.
Grid generation architecture remains optional; implement explicit authored modules with stable IDs now.
